fields.narration: The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead proposes: block the OEM update endpoint at HUOG-FW01 outside the Tuesday window; disable update prompts on every GCS; reinstall 03.2026-B on UAS-02 after repair with a parameter readback; and file the HUOG-ISP 9.4 report recording the cause as an unapproved field update.

snapshot.title: Firmware Patch Validation — UAS-11/12 Test Flights

fields.text: Attention all personnel. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has confirmed that firmware patch v2.3.2 has been fully tested and signed. UAS-11 and UAS-12 may resume flight only after a full verification process: all telemetry logs must be rechecked against the SHA-256 manifest per HUOG-ISP 7.3, and a pre-flight test flight must be conducted under the same conditions as UAS-02’s original mission. No other aircraft will be flown until this process is complete.
fields.zones: ALL HANGAR ZONES, INCIDENT COMMAND POST, GCS-01/02/03/04/05/06 WORKSTATIONS
fields.voiceDirection: Calm, clear male voice, moderate pace, slight reverb
fields.terminalAmbience: Control room hum, distant radio chatter, occasional keyboard taps
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on all facility PA zones while the verification checklist is displayed on the main screen. Do not explain it.
fields.scenarioTitle: Lost Signal — Link Failure & Class C Incursion

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the recovery path. The ASO and SCL must now begin the log verification and test flight planning. Watch for any attempt to bypass the SHA-256 check or initiate new firmware pushes.
